requirements.statement: The authoritative framework namespace SHALL be rooted at repo/ in the repository.
FS0 SHALL contain exactly one foundational Framework Contract authority.
The Framework Contract SHALL explicitly delegate to Governance, Conformance, and Assurance.
Every accepted authority SHALL have a stable machine-resolvable identity.
Every independently governed semantic invariant SHALL have exactly one controlling normative authority owner.
Maintained governed framework state SHALL require positive authorization or an explicit governed extension point.

Implementation, validation output, review findings, generated artifacts, workflow convention, historical state, product behavior, and technical write capability SHALL NOT independently create normative authority.
Normative authority dependencies SHALL be acyclic.
Every maintained derived framework primitive SHALL have resolvable provenance to accepted normative authority.
Each accepted normative obligation SHALL be represented by an identified requirement with owner, statement, lifecycle state, lineage where applicable, and Conformance and Assurance applicability.
Bootstrap SHALL NOT initialize the target Git repository, create the GitHub repository, or establish user credentials.
Before mutation, bootstrap SHALL verify the target repository, GitHub remote, Git authentication, GitHub API authentication, network connectivity, and required technical capabilities.

The operating substrate SHALL provide Git operations, authenticated GitHub API access, HTTPS/TLS and name resolution, maintained-script execution, remote Conformance evidence retrieval, and accepted-state publication.
Authentication secrets, tokens, private keys, and equivalent credentials SHALL remain external to repository-maintained state.
GitHub SHALL be the required initial FS0 operating platform.

FS0 SHALL support repository read/write; Git ref read/create/update; issue and pull-request operations; workflow/check and commit/status reads; event-driven workflow execution; and authenticated actor resolution.
Bootstrap SHALL generate README.md, AGENTS.md, and LICENSE at repository root.
README.md and AGENTS.md SHALL remain subordinate operational orientation surfaces.
The bootstrap prototype and initial installed FS0 SHALL use GNU General Public License version 3 unless later accepted Governance changes that decision where legally permitted.
repo/bootstrap/ SHALL contain only Design input, canonical maintenance inputs, and implementation required to construct, verify, accept, cut over, and maintain FS0.
